app.name: Lumen
app.tagline: A 90-second heart check with the phone in your pocket.
consent.core: Lumen is a screening tool, not a diagnosis.
prototype.banner: Screening prototype — not a diagnosis, not FDA-cleared.
result.notChecked: Not checked: blood pressure, blood oxygen, heart attack.
safety.question: Any chest pain, fainting, or severe shortness of breath right now?
emergency.title: Get help now
emergency.callFailed: This phone couldn’t start the call. Dial 911 from your phone app.
appearance.title: Appearance

consent.title: What Lumen is — and isn't
consent.canPulse: Measure your pulse, with a quality check
consent.canRhythm: Check your pulse rhythm for irregular patterns
consent.canHrv: Track heart rate variability and breathing
consent.cannotReplace: Replace an ECG or a doctor
consent.cannotDetect: Detect a heart attack or measure blood pressure
consent.callWarning: Chest pain or trouble breathing? Call 911 — don't take a reading.
consent.understand: I understand Lumen is a screening tool, not a diagnosis.
profile.title: About you
profile.subtitle: Used to read your results correctly. Stored only on this phone.
profile.note: These change thresholds. A pacemaker turns off rhythm screening.
phoneCheck.title: Checking your phone
phoneCheck.subtitle: About 10 seconds. Keep the app open.
phoneCheck.nextStep: Next we'll test how well your flash reaches your finger. That sets your final Lumen rating.
placement.title: Where your finger goes
placement.tipWipe: Wipe the lens if it's smudged
practice.title: Practice reading
practice.subtitle: Slide your finger until the bar says Strong, then hold still.
howToSit.title: How to sit
howToSit.subtitle: Steady arms and warm hands give the cleanest pulse.
howToSit.warm: Hands warm (rub them if they feel cold)
rating.title: Your Lumen rating
rating.subtitle: Measured on this phone, with your finger
reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.subtitle: Readings at the same time each day are the easiest to compare. Lumen can also remind you about follow-up checks.
reminders.localOnly: Local reminders only. Nothing is sent anywhere, and your lock screen never shows health details.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.limit: At most 3 reminders a day. Your lock screen never shows health details.
trends.title: Trends

learn.lessonLimits: What Lumen can't measure, and why
learn.offline: Lessons work offline and are available in English and Spanish.

mode.fullBody: Rate, rhythm, HRV, breathing + experimental pulse shape
mode.standingBody: How much your heart rate rises when you stand up
precheck.title: Before you start
precheck.reminderFlat: Finger flat across the lens and flash
precheck.reminderElbows: Elbows on a table, phone at chest height
processing.title: Analyzing your reading
processing.subtitle: Usually under 3 seconds
processing.rhythm: Checked rhythm with the AI model
inconclusive.tipElbows: Rest both elbows on a table
standing.title: Standing heart-rate test
standing.interval: The flashlight stays off between readings to keep your phone cool.
standing.safety: Hold on to something steady. Sit down if you feel faint.

phoneRating.title: Your phone
phoneRating.tip: Signal suddenly weaker? Remove thick cases and wipe the lens.
lab.title: Lab mode
accuracy.title: How accurate is Lumen?
accuracy.subtitle: Numbers from our own tests, read from the app's evidence file.
accuracy.falseAlarms: Even a good screening test gives many false alarms when a condition is rare. That's why Lumen asks for repeat readings and suggests a doctor, not a diagnosis.
appearance.followingBody: Lumen switches between light and dark with your phone's setting. Choose Light or Dark to keep one look.
appearance.note: The Doctor PDF is always light, and the emergency screen keeps its red colors in both modes.
widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.howToAdd: How to add: touch and hold the home screen, tap Edit, then Add Widget, and choose Lumen.
widgets.buttons: Buttons open a check right away. Numbers hide with “Hide values on widgets.”
widgets.androidBody: Same small and medium widgets. Touch and hold the home screen, tap Widgets, and drag Lumen onto it.
lockScreen.title: Lock-screen previews
emergency.body: Chest pain, fainting, or trouble breathing with an unusual heart reading can be an emergency.
emergency.strokeLetters: Balance · Eyes · Face · Arm · Speech · Time to call 911
followUp.title: Did you get a chance to see a doctor?
followUp.subtitle: If Lumen suggested a doctor visit, tell us how it went. Your answer stays on this phone.
followUp.whatToAskBody: An ECG for the rhythm result. An A1c blood test for the diabetes pattern. Bring your Lumen report.
